test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill in the blanks.

It was against her ________ to earn more _________ than that decided by the board of directors.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**principle**" refers to** a fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior.**
 
• "**Profit**" refers to **the financial gain made in a transaction.**
 
• The other options do not correctly fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"It was against her **principle** to earn more **profit **than that decided by the board of directors."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Principle** is often confused with **principal**, which can mean a person who has controlling authority or is a leading performer.
 
• **Profit** should not be confused with **prophet**, which refers to a person regarded as an inspired teacher or proclaimer of the will of God.
 
• Understanding the context of the sentence helps in choosing the correct homophones.
